metadata.question: Between 2003 and 2019, did global land area covered by crops increase by at least 5 percent?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy (Collection, Date, Location): - Use MODIS Land Cover (MCD12Q1) annual product, available 2001-present, 500 m resolution. - Bands: ‘LC_Type1’ (IGBP) where classes 12 & 14 are croplands (12=Croplands, 14=Croplands/Natural vegetation mosaic). - Time: 2003 and 2019 (two single-year images). - Location: global land – use a coarse sampling grid (1° spacing) and aggregate to avoid memory/time-out. 2. Masking strategy: - Mask oceans with the internal ‘land’ QA, plus a simple elevation mask (JRC > 0) to focus on land. - No cloud masking needed; land-cover product is annual classification. 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - Compute fractional cropland area for 2003 and 2019 across sampled land points. - If either year has 0 valid pixels → C2. - If computed fractions are None/NaN → C3. - Otherwise, check if 2019 fraction ≥ 1.05 × 2003 fraction → A, else B. ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry – sample global land on 1° grid to stay within quota grid = ee.FeatureCollection( [ee.Feature(ee.Geometry.Point([lon, lat]).buffer(50000, 1)) for lat in range(-80, 81, 10) for lon in range(-180, 181, 10)] ) def crop_frac(year): img = ( ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MCD12Q1') .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(year, year, 'year')) .first() .select('LC_Type1') ) if img is None or img.bandNames().getInfo() is None: return None crop = img.eq(12).Or(img.eq(14)) # cropland classes area = crop.multiply(ee.Image.pixelArea()).rename('cropArea') total = ee.Image.constant(1).multiply(ee.Image.pixelArea()).rename('totalArea') stats = area.addBands(total).reduceRegions( collection=grid, reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(), scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9 ) tot_crop = stats.aggregate_sum('cropArea').getInfo() tot_land = stats.aggregate_sum('totalArea').getInfo() return None if tot_land == 0 else tot_crop / tot_land frac03 = crop_frac(2003) frac19 = crop_frac(2019) print(f"2003 crop fraction: {frac03:.4f}" if frac03 is not None else "2003: None") print(f"2019 crop fraction: {frac19:.4f}" if frac19 is not None else "2019: None") if frac03 is None or frac19 is None: print("C3") elif frac03 == 0: print("C2") else: print(f"Increase: {(frac19/frac03-1)*100:.1f}%") print("A" if (frac19 / frac03) >= 1.05 else "B") ```

import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry – sample global land on 1° grid to stay within quota
grid = ee.FeatureCollection(
    [ee.Feature(ee.Geometry.Point([lon, lat]).buffer(50000, 1))
     for lat in range(-80, 81, 10) for lon in range(-180, 181, 10)]
)

def crop_frac(year):
    img = (
        ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MCD12Q1')
        .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(year, year, 'year'))
        .first()
        .select('LC_Type1')
    )
    if img is None or img.bandNames().getInfo() is None:
        return None
    crop = img.eq(12).Or(img.eq(14))  # cropland classes
    area = crop.multiply(ee.Image.pixelArea()).rename('cropArea')
    total = ee.Image.constant(1).multiply(ee.Image.pixelArea()).rename('totalArea')
    stats = area.addBands(total).reduceRegions(
        collection=grid,
        reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(),
        scale=1000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    )
    tot_crop = stats.aggregate_sum('cropArea').getInfo()
    tot_land = stats.aggregate_sum('totalArea').getInfo()
    return None if tot_land == 0 else tot_crop / tot_land

frac03 = crop_frac(2003)
frac19 = crop_frac(2019)

print(f"2003 crop fraction: {frac03:.4f}" if frac03 is not None else "2003: None")
print(f"2019 crop fraction: {frac19:.4f}" if frac19 is not None else "2019: None")

if frac03 is None or frac19 is None:
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")
elif frac03 == 0:
    print("<answer>C2</answer>")
else:
    print(f"Increase: {(frac19/frac03-1)*100:.1f}%")
    print("<answer>A</answer>" if (frac19 / frac03) >= 1.05 else "<answer>B</answer>")
